title: Sediment inflow, outflow and deposition for Lakes Marion and Moultrie, South Carolina, October 1983 - March 1985
citation: Cooney, T.W., 1988, Sediment inflow, outflow and deposition for Lakes Marion and Moultrie, South Carolina, October 1983 - March 1985: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 88-4160, map scale 1:750,000.
notes:
Sediment-transport report for Lakes Marion and Moultrie; the whole PDF is this one report. The only geologic content is table 1 (page 9, taken from USDA 1973), which lists major formations/belts and ages by physiographic province of the Santee River basin. Each name is paired with its province column by position (flagged inferred); the province ages are given for the province as a whole, not per formation, so no per-unit ages were recorded. 'Bravard Belt' is kept as spelled in the source. Streamflow, suspended-sediment, particle-size and bed-material tables (tables 2-15) are gaging-station hydrology data, not geologic observations, and were not recorded. Figure 3 (page 40) is unreadable plot text.
Pages 47-52 are comparison tables and text on streamflow and suspended sediment (no geologic units, observations or aquifers). Page 53 is the reference list: only the references bearing on South Carolina were recorded; general sediment and streamflow method references (Carswell, Colby, Colby and Hubbell, Guy, Guy and Norman, Porterfield, Rantz, Stevens, USGS 1966-68 national water-quality reports, USGS 1977 handbook) were skipped.
